system.boundary: Build a three-dimensional physical multibody forklift that performs a complete warehouse handling mission: approach and pick up a rigid payload, lift and tilt it with physical mast and fork mechanisms, drive over a transverse rounded floor obstacle, transport the payload, and place it on an elevated rack.
engineering_objects: Build a three-dimensional physical multibody forklift that performs a complete warehouse handling mission: approach and pick up a rigid payload, lift and tilt it with physical mast and fork mechanisms, drive over a transverse rounded floor obstacle, transport the payload, and place it on an elevated rack.
The vehicle must include a rigid chassis, four independently contacting wheels, a steerable running gear, physical lift and tilt actuation, fork-payload contact, and a freely moving payload.
Motion and payload handling must arise from the connected physical mechanism and contact forces rather than prescribed vehicle or payload coordinates.
physical_paths: Motion and payload handling must arise from the connected physical mechanism and contact forces rather than prescribed vehicle or payload coordinates.
The complete pickup, obstacle-traversal, transport, and placement sequence must remain physically stable throughout these ranges and finish within 60 seconds.
